items.title: Gold Loses Shine Amid Navratri: Yellow Metal Prices Fall Below Rs 1,48,000; Silver Prices Drop By Over Rs 2,000
items.summary: Gold prices fell below Rs 1,48,000 during Wednesday's session, while silver futures declined by more than Rs 2,000 from the previous close. Investors tracked US inflation data and Federal Reserve signals for clues on the outlook for interest rates.

items.title: Gold prices flat as markets await US CPI data
items.summary: In early Asian trading, gold prices held steady as investors awaited crucial US consumer price data, which could affect future Federal Reserve decisions. New York Fed President John Williams spoke about the need for potential interest rate increases to combat inflation. Additionally, Fed Governor Christopher Waller noted that robust economic growth could influence US bond yields, with other precious metals experiencing slight downturns amid the evolving market conditions.

items.title: Dollar languishes as focus turns to CPI, Fed speakers
items.summary: The dollar declined as traders awaited new information on the timing for interest rate increases. Investors reevaluated the recent rally fueled by artificial intelligence developments and easing oil prices. Meanwhile, the euro gained slightly amid regional budget concerns affecting bond yields. The US consumer price index data release is upcoming, alongside important speeches from Federal Reserve officials.

items.title: Ringgit opens marginally higher against US$ on weaker DXY
items.summary: KUALA LUMPUR: The ringgit opened marginally higher against the US dollar on Wednesday, supported by a weaker US Dollar Index (DXY) as investors reassessed the outlook for US interest rates following signals that the Federal Reserve may adopt a less aggressive monetary policy stance.

items.title: Fed’s Collins Sees Higher Rates Likely This Year to Tame Prices
items.summary: Federal Reserve Bank of Boston President Susan Collins said interest rates will likely need to rise more before the end of the year to help rein in inflation.

items.title: NY Fed President Williams sees no need for a rate hike in 2027
items.summary: At a recent conference, John Williams from the Federal Reserve Bank of New York expressed optimism about a potential interest-rate increase this year, suggesting inflation could hit the 2% goal by next year. He cited the role of artificial intelligence in affecting inflation rates while also addressing the sector's supply-demand imbalance.

items.title: Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago President Austan Goolsbee Warns AI Boom May Be Fueling Inflation Overheating
items.summary: Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago President Austan Goolsbee warned that AI investment booms may be fueling aggregate overheating and persistent inflation.

items.title: Stock market today: Why are S&P 500 futures falling despite strong bank earnings?
items.summary: S&P 500 futures fell as chip stocks slid and US bank earnings began, while investors awaited inflation data and clues on the Federal Reserve's rate decision.
